title: Checkout down, nothing deployed
alert: ServiceDown on payments; HighErrorRate on orders and api-gateway
query: Nothing at all is going through checkout. Orders keeps logging 'Name or service not known' for the payments host, and nobody pushed anything today.
root_cause: The payments container is not running.

remediation.detail: Start or restart the payments service.

evidence: Orders logs show payment failed with name or service not known
The deploy log has no recent entries
